title: The Right Mindset
warning_text: ⚠️ In all of your games, you are going to mute the chat (both allied and enemy) and mute enemy emotes to avoid distractions
img_alt: How to mute the game chat
img_subtext: Keep this configuration above (make sure to also check the emotes box)
js_texts: The amygdala takes over. (The part of the brain responsible for 'fight or flight' emotional responses)
It temporarily deactivates the prefrontal cortex, which is the brain area responsible for logical thinking, planning, and impulse control. You stop thinking and start just reacting.
You tilt when you want the game to go one way, but the actions of your allies or enemies show that you have no control over the match.
When you notice it, the best technical decision to make is to pause, take a deep breath, and step away from the game for a while until the prefrontal cortex regains control.
